claims.claim_text: The indexed Hans Simons is a high-confidence match to the New School dean who briefly worked for OSS as a Germany expert.

claims.claim_text: Hans Simons was employed by the New School as a political scientist and Graduate Faculty dean when he briefly worked for OSS as a Germany expert.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Kurzzeitig war Simons auch als Deutschlandexperte für das Office of Strategic Services tätig
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The institutional history dates his New School faculty work from 1935 and deanship from 1943; the scholarly review places brief OSS work in that wartime academic chronology.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the distinctive exact name and direct biographical OSS linkage.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded and overlapping wartime employment; the sources do not use an explicit 'recruited from' formulation or supply an OSS start date.
claims.match_notes: The New School is treated as both the immediate documented civilian affiliation and last civilian employer before the brief OSS work; earlier German posts remain earlier affiliations.

claims.temporal_assessment: Documented wartime affiliation, but the exact Army-to-OSS sequence and immediate predecessor status remain uncertain.
claims.match_notes: This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer. The company founded in 1948 is explicitly excluded as postwar.
